signatures.title: D3D12 renderer fails at startup
signatures.headline: Luduvo's D3D12 renderer fails on your PC before the game opens. This is a known Luduvo bug, not your PC.
signatures.summary: A popup says Luduvo failed to launch and to check client.log. Studio says the Client did not start.
signatures.who: Anyone whose game ends up on D3D12. Build 45 starts Windows PCs on D3D12, and on 26 Sep players posted this failure from a GTX 1050, a GTX 1650, an RX 6600, a Ryzen laptop and an Intel UHD laptop. On build 44 it was mostly Intel UHD and HD laptops, plus a GTX 1650 and an RX 9060 XT.

cause.text: One of Luduvo's D3D12 compute shaders fails to build on these drivers. matt traced it to the cluster build-grid shader, and said it may not be the only one.

all: \[nvrhi\] Failed to create a compute pipeline state object
ClusteredForward: failed to create build-grid pipeline

symptoms: A popup says Luduvo failed to launch and to check client.log
Studio says the Client did not start

steps.text: There's nothing you can fix on your end yet. Reinstalling drivers or Luduvo won't change this one.
Build 45 didn't fix this. Update Luduvo when the next build comes out, then try again.
Follow the main thread for news.

link.label: I cant play luduvo because of this bug

dont: Reinstalling your graphics driver again. Players on up-to-date drivers hit this too.
Patching or swapping Luduvo's shader files. The integrity check puts them back, and it's against Luduvo's terms.

staff_note.quote: This will most likely be resolved in tomorrow's update, Luduvo 45. If it continues, please let us know.
staff_note.context: Build 45 came out on 26 Sep, and logs posted that day still show this failure. Staff haven't posted about it on the forum since.

credits.for: traced the failure to a D3D12 shader
the clearest build 44 report

signatures.title: D3D12 used without trying Vulkan
signatures.headline: Your game went straight to D3D12 without trying Vulkan first. On build 45 every Windows log posted so far does this.
signatures.summary: The log shows D3D12 starting up with no Vulkan lines before it.
signatures.who: Every build 45 log posted on 26 Sep, on NVIDIA, AMD and Intel. Before that, an AMD RX 9060 XT on builds 41 and 44.

cause.text: An early release note said Windows users default to D3D12. If Settings.cfg says graphics_api=D3D12, Luduvo may skip Vulkan entirely. Build 45 seems to start every Windows PC on D3D12, and nobody has said yet whether the setting still changes that.

steps.text: Press Win + R, paste %APPDATA%\Luduvo\Client and press Enter. Copy Settings.cfg somewhere safe first.
Open Settings.cfg in Notepad and find the graphics_api line.
If it says D3D12 and your graphics card supports Vulkan 1.3, you could change it to Vulkan and save. Nobody on the forum has confirmed this fixes the client yet.

dont: Editing any other Luduvo file.

sources.label: AMD log with no Vulkan attempt, build 41
AMD log with no Vulkan attempt, build 44
NVIDIA log with no Vulkan attempt, build 45
Intel log with no Vulkan attempt, build 45
Switching Studio to Vulkan fixed a D3D12 crash in July

credits.for: showed switching the API can help

signatures.title: AMD graphics driver crashes on Windows
signatures.headline: Your AMD graphics driver is crashing when Luduvo starts. This is a known Luduvo bug, not your PC.
signatures.summary: A black screen for a couple of seconds, then the window closes. No error popup.
signatures.who: AMD graphics on Windows using Vulkan: RX 6700 XT, RX 6500 XT and many Ryzen laptop chips. Some RX 580, RX 570 and RX 9060 XT cards work. Build 45 starts on D3D12 instead of Vulkan, so AMD players on 45 are getting the D3D12 startup failure rather than this crash.

cause.text: Luduvo crashes inside AMD's Vulkan driver, amdvlk64.dll. matt said neither main engine developer has an AMD card to test on.

hint.say: client.log looks normal but stops early on an AMD card. That's how this crash looks, but the proof is in crash.log. Drop crash.log from the same folder to be sure.

symptoms: A black screen for a few seconds, then the game closes (AMD graphics)

steps.text: There's nothing you can fix on Windows yet. Staff said on 23 Sep it'll be fixed by October.
If you already have Linux on this PC, several players with the same hardware say Luduvo works there.
Follow the AMD thread for news.

dont: Reinstalling your AMD driver. It doesn't help with this one.
Clearing your shader cache.
Downloading DLL files from other sites.

staff_note.quote: This will be resolved by October.

sources.label: Works on Linux with the same PC
RX 6600 on build 45, now failing on D3D12

credits.for: worked out that the AMD driver is what crashes
the thread that got crash.log added
found Luduvo works on Linux on the same PC
confirmed the Linux workaround

signatures.title: Intel graphics blocked from Vulkan
signatures.headline: Luduvo skipped your Intel graphics for Vulkan on purpose, because that driver crashes. It then tried D3D12, which failed too.
signatures.summary: Luduvo fails to launch on a laptop with Intel UHD or HD graphics.
signatures.who: Intel 7th to 10th gen integrated graphics (Kaby Lake, Coffee Lake, Comet Lake), for example UHD 620 and HD 620.

cause.text: Luduvo blocks these Intel drivers because their Vulkan 1.3 support crashes at runtime. Build 44 falls back to D3D12, which then hits the D3D12 startup bug.

steps.text: There's nothing you can fix on your end yet. A newer Intel driver doesn't take these chips off the list.
The real blocker is the D3D12 bug listed with this. Once that's fixed, the fallback should get you in.

dont: Setting LDV_VK_SKIP_BLOCKLIST=1. It gets further, then the game floods with Device Removed errors.
Installing the LunarG Vulkan runtime or older Intel drivers. Players in thread 2616 tried both.

credits.for: showed what happens with the override on

signatures.title: Graphics only supports Vulkan 1.2
signatures.headline: Your graphics card or its driver only offers Vulkan 1.2. Luduvo needs Vulkan 1.3, so it tried D3D12 instead.
signatures.summary: Luduvo fails to launch on older graphics.
signatures.who: Older graphics such as Intel UHD 600 and the GeForce GT 710.

steps.text: Look for a newer graphics driver from your laptop maker or the chip maker's own site. A newer driver sometimes adds Vulkan 1.3.
If there's no newer driver, this hardware is below what Luduvo needs right now. Isaac confirmed a DirectX 11 renderer is in development.

dont: Downloading drivers or DLLs from unofficial sites.

staff_note.context: Replying to a player who said a DirectX 11 renderer is in development.

credits.for: suggested checking for a newer driver

signatures.title: Graphics can't run D3D12 feature level 12.0
signatures.headline: Your graphics card can't create the kind of D3D12 device Luduvo needs, and Vulkan wasn't available either.
signatures.summary: A popup says: No compatible GPU found. Luduvo requires a compatible Vulkan 1.3/ Metal3/ D3D12 GPU or driver.
signatures.who: Graphics from around 2012 or earlier, such as Intel HD 2000 (Sandy Bridge), Ivy Bridge graphics and the GeForce GT 710.

all: no adapter satisfies D3D12 feature level 12\.0

symptoms: No compatible GPU found. Luduvo requires a compatible Vulkan 1.3/ Metal3/ D3D12 GPU or driver.

steps.text: Check for a newer graphics driver. On hardware this old there usually isn't one that helps.
Luduvo doesn't support this graphics hardware yet. Staff say a DirectX 11 renderer is coming, and OpenGL isn't planned.

dont: Reinstalling Luduvo. It won't change what your graphics card supports.

staff_note.quote: vulkan, dx12 and dx11 of which vulkan and dx12 are already in use

signatures.title: GPU blocklist override is switched on
signatures.headline: LDV_VK_SKIP_BLOCKLIST is set on this PC. That forces Luduvo onto a graphics driver it knows is broken.
signatures.summary: Someone followed the hint in the error message and switched the blocklist off.
signatures.who: Anyone who set the LDV_VK_SKIP_BLOCKLIST environment variable.

steps.text: Search Windows for "Edit environment variables for your account" and open it.
Select LDV_VK_SKIP_BLOCKLIST in the top list, click Delete, then OK.
Start Luduvo again. You'll most likely land on the Intel blocklist issue, which has no fix yet, but your PC won't be fighting a broken driver.

dont: Setting the override again.

credits.for: posted the log that showed it

signatures.title: Graphics device lost after joining
signatures.headline: Your graphics driver stopped responding after you joined a game, and Luduvo lost the GPU.
signatures.summary: The game or the Studio viewport freezes. Windows may say it blocked LuduvoEditor.exe from accessing graphics hardware.
signatures.who: Seen on Intel HD 620 with the blocklist override switched on.
symptoms: Windows says it blocked LuduvoEditor.exe from accessing graphics hardware

steps.text: If LDV_VK_SKIP_BLOCKLIST is set, remove it first. That's almost certainly the cause.
Otherwise, update your graphics driver and try again. If it keeps happening, send the report below.

dont: Disabling Windows' GPU protection or editing the registry to stop the warning.

credits.for: posted the log

signatures.title: Vulkan found no graphics card
signatures.headline: Vulkan couldn't see any graphics card on your PC. From build 44, Luduvo then tries D3D12.
signatures.summary: Luduvo fails to launch on a laptop with two graphics chips.
signatures.who: Seen on a laptop with AMD Vega 10 and NVIDIA GTX 1650 graphics.

steps.text: If you're on build 43 or older, update Luduvo. Build 44 falls back to D3D12 when this happens.
Update the drivers for both graphics chips, from your laptop maker's site if it has them.
If the D3D12 error shows up after that, it's the bug everyone is waiting on.

dont: Downloading Vulkan DLLs from other sites.

staff_note.quote: will be fixed soon. The vulkan drivers lack certain features. The d3d12 backend will be enabled in the next update

signatures.title: Broken Vulkan install stops the window opening
signatures.headline: Your PC's Vulkan install is broken, so Luduvo couldn't open a window. Build 44 works around this by switching to D3D12.
signatures.summary: Luduvo fails to launch straight away on builds 39 to 43.
signatures.who: Seen on an RX 5700 XT, Intel HD 2000 and others.

all: Failed to create window: Installed Vulkan doesn't implement the VK_KHR_surface extension

steps.text: Update Luduvo to build 44 or newer. It switches to D3D12 when Vulkan is broken.
Update your graphics driver from the chip maker's own site.

dont: Deleting Vulkan registry entries by hand or copying Vulkan files into System32. One player got Studio working that way, but it's easy to break Windows.

staff_note.quote: vulkan drivers on windows are very buggy

credits.for: credited in the build 44 notes for the fallback fix

signatures.title: Vulkan unavailable, D3D12 used instead
signatures.headline: Vulkan isn't working on your PC, so Luduvo switched to D3D12 for this run.
signatures.summary: The log says Vulkan is unavailable and D3D12 is being used.
signatures.who: PCs with a broken or missing Vulkan install, on build 44 or newer.

steps.text: On its own this is fine. Luduvo can run on D3D12.
If something failed after the switch, it's listed under this. Start there.
A newer graphics driver may bring Vulkan back.

credits.for: credited in the build 44 notes for the fallback fix

signatures.title: vulkan-1.dll was not found
signatures.headline: Windows can't find Vulkan on your PC. Your graphics driver normally installs it.
signatures.summary: A Windows popup: The code execution cannot proceed because vulkan-1.dll was not found.
signatures.who: PCs with an old or incomplete graphics driver.
symptoms: The code execution cannot proceed because vulkan-1.dll was not found

steps.text: Update your graphics driver from NVIDIA, AMD or Intel's own website, then restart your PC.
If that doesn't do it, install the Vulkan Runtime from LunarG's official site (vulkan.lunarg.com) and restart.

dont: Downloading vulkan-1.dll on its own from a DLL site. Those files can be anything.

credits.for: warned against DLL download sites
suggested the Vulkan Runtime

signatures.title: A recorder or overlay crashes Luduvo
signatures.headline: Luduvo crashed inside another program's file, not Luduvo's or your graphics driver's. Screen recorders and overlays hook into games like this.
signatures.summary: The game closes at startup. crash.log names a file from another program's folder.
signatures.who: Confirmed with Bandicam installed. Other recorders and overlays are a guess.

cause.text: Bandicam's Vulkan layer is the only confirmed case. Other overlays could do the same.

steps.text: Look at the crash line for the program's folder, for example Bandicam.
Close that program, or uninstall it from Windows Settings, then start Luduvo again. Uninstalling Bandicam's layer fixed it for the player who found this.

dont: Deleting files out of another program's folder. Uninstall it properly instead.
Turning off your antivirus.

sources.label: Installed Vulkan layers show in client.log

credits.for: found the Bandicam file was the cause

signatures.title: Vulkan validation warnings
signatures.headline: Vulkan validation warnings. They're harmless and don't explain a crash.
signatures.summary: Lines about vertex attributes not consumed by the vertex shader.
signatures.who: Anyone with Vulkan validation layers switched on.

steps.text: Ignore these. Staff need the whole log, not just these lines.

staff_note.quote: this doesnt help with the bug : share the full log (omit information you deem personal)

signatures.summary: Hundreds of lines saying texel walks were truncated and shadows are missing.
signatures.who: Everyone.

any: Razor: up to \d+ texel walks truncated at RAZOR_MAX_WALK

steps.text: Ignore these.

sources.label: 533 of them in my own healthy build 44 log

signatures.title: Part with an unusable scale

signatures.summary: A physics warning naming a part with an unusable Scale.
signatures.who: Anyone joining that game.

steps.text: Ignore it.

sources.label: In my own healthy build 44 log

signatures.title: Folder isn't a Luduvo project
signatures.headline: Studio was pointed at a folder that isn't a Luduvo project. Harmless.
signatures.summary: An error saying there's no project.json in a folder.
signatures.who: Anyone who opened the wrong folder in Studio.

steps.text: Open the project's own folder, the one with project.json in it.

signatures.title: Corrupted content cache
signatures.headline: Luduvo's downloaded content folder is corrupted, so it can't update itself.
signatures.summary: Luduvo won't update and keeps using old content.
signatures.who: Seen on build 39 during launch week.

all: MoveFileExW: Cannot create a file when that file already exists

steps.text: Close Luduvo completely.
Press Win + R, paste %APPDATA%\Luduvo and press Enter.
Copy Client\Settings.cfg somewhere safe if you want to keep your settings.
Delete the Luduvo folder you just opened, then start Luduvo. It downloads fresh content.

dont: Deleting anything outside that Luduvo folder.

staff_note.quote: delete the appdata/Roaming/Luduvo completely it looks like its corrupted.

credits.for: credited in the build 40 notes for the cache fix

signatures.title: Shader files missing
signatures.headline: Luduvo couldn't find its shader files, so the renderer couldn't start.
signatures.summary: Luduvo fails to launch after an update. Seen on launch day.
signatures.who: Windows players around launch day, 12 to 13 Sep.

any: Load_shader: failed to read transpiled shader
FATAL: shader directory '[^']*' does not exist

steps.text: Update Luduvo. This was a launch-day bug and hasn't turned up in build 44 logs.
If it still happens, close Luduvo, press Win + R, paste %APPDATA%\Luduvo\Client and delete the content folder. Luduvo downloads it again next time.

dont: Copying shader files from someone else's PC.

staff_note.quote: Some of you who previously installed or joined Luduvo were completely locked out due to a shader issue. This is our top priority

credits.for: reported it with the full log

signatures.title: Non-Latin Windows username breaks the launcher
signatures.headline: Your Windows username has non-Latin letters in it. Before build 44 that made the launcher close without a word.
signatures.summary: Luduvo.exe opens in the background and closes after a few seconds.
signatures.who: Windows users whose username uses Cyrillic, Greek or accented letters, on build 43 or older.
symptoms: Luduvo.exe opens in the background and closes after a few seconds

steps.text: Update Luduvo to build 44 or newer. That build fixed the launcher for Cyrillic and other non-Latin usernames.

dont: Renaming your Windows user folder. It can break other programs.

sources.label: Windows 10 report with an accented name

credits.for: reported it; credited in the build 44 notes
confirmed the fix works

signatures.title: Content folder can't be created under a non-Latin username
signatures.headline: Luduvo couldn't create its content folder under your Windows username, which has non-Latin letters in it.
signatures.summary: The log warns it cannot create a content folder under your user profile.
signatures.who: Seen once, with a Greek username on build 42.

cause.text: The one report also had an AMD Vega 8, so the AMD driver crash may be the real reason the game didn't start.

steps.text: Update Luduvo first. Build 44 fixed a related launcher bug for non-Latin usernames.
If it still happens on build 44 or newer, send the report below. Changing the APPDATA folder and the UTF-8 beta setting didn't help the player who tried them.

dont: Renaming your Windows user folder. It can break other programs.

signatures.title: Launcher can't download updates
signatures.headline: The launcher couldn't reach Luduvo's update server, so it started the copy you already had.
signatures.summary: Luduvo won't update, or starts an old version that can't join games.
signatures.who: Players on flaky networks, VPNs or networks behind a Cloudflare check.

any: curl: \(22\) The requested URL returned error: 403

steps.text: Try a different network, for example your phone's hotspot, with any VPN or proxy turned off.
Close Luduvo. If there's a file called .luduvo-update.lock in %LocalAppData%\Luduvo, delete it, then start Luduvo again.
If it keeps failing, reinstall Luduvo from luduvo.com/download.

staff_note.quote: Is under investigation. Is a VPN in use?

credits.for: found it worked on another network
pointed at the update lock file

signatures.title: Disconnected: the connection broke
signatures.headline: The server dropped you because a packet arrived garbled. A VPN or proxy seems to cause this.
signatures.summary: You join a game and get "Disconnected: the connection broke" straight away.
signatures.who: Players on a VPN or proxy.

steps.text: If you use a VPN, proxy or network filter, turn it off and try again.
If you don't use one, send the report below. This one is still open.
If Luduvo isn't available in your country, there's no supported way around that yet.

credits.for: worked out the VPN link

signatures.title: Can't connect to the game server
signatures.headline: Your client couldn't reach Luduvo's game server.
signatures.summary: The game loads, then never connects. Input and camera stop responding.
signatures.who: Seen from Iran and on stale launch links.

steps.text: Close Luduvo, refresh the game page in your browser and press Join again.
Try another network with any VPN turned off.
Advanced: in PowerShell, run Test-NetConnection with the address and port from the highlighted line, for example Test-NetConnection 5.78.177.147 -Port 27015.
Players in Iran report that the server host blocks their connection. There's no fix for that on your end.

staff_note.quote: did you refresh the brower page and launch the game again?

credits.for: suggested the Test-NetConnection check
passed on the hosting explanation

signatures.title: Join does nothing on macOS
signatures.headline: On macOS, the Join button can't find the game client yet. Studio works, but joining from the website doesn't.
signatures.summary: The browser asks to open Luduvo URI Handler, then nothing happens.
signatures.who: Mac players (Apple Silicon preview).

cause.text: The URI handler looks for an app in /Applications, but the Mac download isn't packaged as an app yet, so the handler times out.

symptoms: Clicking Join on a Mac does nothing
The browser asks to open Luduvo URI Handler, then nothing happens

steps.text: There's no simple fix yet. Studio works in the meantime.
Advanced: tunics posted a way to start the game from Terminal with the launch link. You have to be quick, because the link expires.

dont: Moving the Luduvo folder into Applications. It doesn't help, because the client isn't an .app yet.

staff_note.quote: there are some issues with launching games on mac, but the studio should work fine

credits.for: worked out why the handler times out

signatures.title: Studio needs libxcb-cursor0 on Linux
signatures.headline: Studio needs a system library your Linux install doesn't have: libxcb-cursor0.
signatures.summary: Studio aborts on start with a Qt platform plugin error.
signatures.who: Seen on Linux Mint 22.3.

steps.text: Install libxcb-cursor0 with your package manager. On Ubuntu or Mint: sudo apt install libxcb-cursor0
Start Studio again from the terminal.

signatures.title: Missing shared library on Linux
signatures.headline: Luduvo needs a system library that isn't installed on your Linux PC.
signatures.summary: Luduvo won't start and the terminal says it can't load a shared library.
signatures.who: Seen on a fresh Ubuntu install.

all: error while loading shared libraries: \S+: cannot open shared object file

steps.text: The missing file is named in the highlighted line. For libOpenGL.so.0, install your distro's libopengl0 package, for example sudo apt install libopengl0.
For any other file, search your distro's packages for that file name.

signatures.title: No client.log on Linux

steps.text: Open a terminal and run luduvo --singleplayer.
When it fails, copy everything the terminal printed and paste it into the box at the top of this page.
